title: Static search trees: 40x faster than binary search (2024)
summary: A technical article exploring static search trees as a high-performance alternative to binary search, demonstrating 40x speedup through techniques like SIMD vectorization, cache-friendly memory layouts, and branch-free algorithms optimized for modern CPU architectures.
problem_solved: Provides dramatically faster search operations for read-only datasets where data remains static after initialization.
why_valuable: Enables sub-microsecond search times for applications like databases, caches, and real-time systems by leveraging low-level CPU optimizations that standard binary search cannot achieve.
